Class ProcessInstanceService

    • getProcessInstanceIfActive

      public Optional<io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.model.ProcessInstance> getProcessInstanceIfActive(String processInstanceId)
      Retrieves a process instance only if it is in an active state.

      An instance is considered active if it is NOT in CANCELLED, COMPLETED, or TERMINATED state.

      Parameters:
      processInstanceId - The process instance ID.
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the active ProcessInstance, or empty if not found or inactive.

      public boolean hasActiveChildInstances(String parentProcessInstanceId)
      Checks whether any active (non-terminal) child instances exist for a given parent.

      true if at least one child instance is still active.
